plan.goal: Mosaic the four adjacent DEM tiles into a single merged raster covering the full Richland County extent
plan.notes: All source DEMs share the same CRS (EPSG:4326), pixel size (~0.00028°), dtype (int16), and nodata value (-32767). Use nodata-aware merging. The merged extent spans approximately 32.9999°S to 35.0001°N and 82.0001°W to 79.9999°W.

plan.goal: Compute slope (rate of maximum change in elevation) from the merged DEM
plan.notes: Use the merged DEM from step_01 as input. Calculate slope in degrees or percent rise as appropriate for terrain analysis.

plan.goal: Compute aspect (compass direction of the steepest downhill slope) from the merged DEM
plan.notes: Use the merged DEM from step_01 as input. Output values should represent azimuth degrees (0-360) or categorical N/E/S/W directions.

plan.goal: Compute hillshade (shaded relief illumination) from the merged DEM
plan.notes: Use the merged DEM from step_01 as input. Standard azimuth (315°) and altitude (45°) illumination angles recommended.

plan.goal: Compute Terrain Ruggedness Index (TRI) from the merged DEM
plan.notes: TRI = square root of sum of squared differences between cell elevation and all 8 neighboring cell elevations. Use 3x3 neighborhood window. Output in elevation units (same as DEM).

plan.goal: Compute Topographic Position Index (TPI) from the merged DEM
plan.notes: TPI = elevation of cell minus mean elevation of immediate 8 neighbors. Use 3x3 neighborhood window. Positive values indicate ridges/peaks; negative values indicate valleys/canyons. Output in elevation units (same as DEM).
